subject: Re: POC wrap — Ops uplift scorecard + quick advocacy ask
messages:
From: Lena Torres <lena.torres@shopscape.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC results: ShopScape ops pilot wrap

Hi Mateo / Karthik (cc Marissa),

Thanks again for partnering with us on the two-week ops pilot. Attached is the scorecard the team asked for — highlights below: 

- Average pick-to-ship time dropped from 3.2 hrs to 1.8 hrs (44% improvement)
- Automated routing accuracy (first-pass) increased 38% vs baseline
- Predictive restock alerts reduced urgent replenishment events by 22%
- Estimated token cost savings when moving to production: ~$1.6k/month for the tested SKU set

Team is happy with reliability during peak testing window (no incidents). Moving to the next step we discussed: a short customer quote and a 15-minute recording for our site. Would you be open to sharing a one-to-two sentence blurb about the operational uplift + a short call next week?

I've attached the scorecard and the raw logs the engs used for validation. Let me know which day/time works — Ethan (ops lead) is on copy for scheduling.

Attachments: shopscape_poc_scorecard.pdf, raw_validation_logs.zip (see enclosed metadata)

Best,
Lena
Director of Operations
ShopScape

Lena — huge win, thanks for the clear scorecard and for sharing the logs. Really pleased to see the latency and routing gains hold during peak windows.

Two quick asks from our side that are easy and high-impact for your team and ours: 

1) Would ShopScape be comfortable with a two-line quote we could use in a short case blurb? Something like: "Redwood reduced our pick-to-ship time by ~44% across tested SKUs, materially improving our fulfillment throughput." We can draft options for you to approve.

2) A brief 15-minute recording (audio only or Zoom) with you or Ethan that we can clip for a one-minute customer highlight. We promise short, prompt questions and will send the draft before publishing.

If that works, Marissa will coordinate a 15-min slot. Proposed windows: Tue 9/21 10–12 PT or Wed 9/22 14–16 PT. Ethan — if you want to pick a time, we can send a Cal link.

Thanks again — very much appreciate the partnership.

—Mateo
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
